docs.title: Learn Linux
docs.text: Notes, scripts, and mini projects from my Linux, networking, shell scripting, and Git learning journey.

docs.title: What I am learning
docs.text: Area Topics Linux Fundamentals Introduction, file management, users and permissions, processes Text Processing Text processing, advanced text processing and scheduling Networking Basics, OSI model, devices, networking in Linux, security Shell Scripting Introduction, fundamentals, walk through Shell Scripting for DevOps File, process and filesystem management, backup, networking, AI-assisted scripting Git Introduction, Git in DevOps

docs.title: How to use this site
docs.text:
• Browse topics from the left menu, or use the search box.
  • Each page has commands I actually ran, with their real output and the mistakes to avoid.
  • Quick reference: Cheatsheet
